generation.scope: For every cubic through the harmonic pencil base of any finite mixed seed with independent brackets, a geometric-generic all-degree AS finite rank-ten deformation realizes that exact projective cubic. Every planar cubic up to projectivity occurs, including every smooth j-invariant. Through the split tetrahedron the class image for each fixed cubic has dimension six, trivial generic projective automorphisms and generic minimum period four. For a smooth such cubic E the full scheme of complementary three-planes with determinant proportional to its equation is the elliptic normal quintic Pic^2(E), with exactly five specified zero-determinant planes.

open_mathematics: For a fixed trace metric and arbitrary smooth cubic E, characterize which apolar length-four schemes support finite mixed deformations using the degree-six embedding, then analyze ordered bases and inverse-commutator lifts over the elliptic quintic.
